prompt:
CRITICAL ANTI-TEXT DIRECTIVE: ZERO text of ANY kind. No letters, words, numbers, runes, hieroglyphs, symbols, UI text, watermarks, logos. Use ONLY abstract fracture patterns for decorative markings.

CRITICAL: NO HALO RINGS. No circular discs behind head. No glowing rings.
CRITICAL: NO ANIMALS AT FEET. No companion animals, no creatures. Energy/void patterns only.
CRITICAL: THE HOLLOW IS NOT A PLAYABLE DEITY. This creature must look INCOMPLETE, FRACTURED, CORRUPTED. Where deities radiate divine light, this creature ABSORBS light. Where deities are alive, this creature is ABSENCE. Where deities have faces, this creature has broken or missing masks.
CRITICAL: HOLLOW AESTHETIC — charcoal-black void-stuff body (pure absence given form, NOT metal, NOT stone, NOT flesh). White fracture cracks (cold white lines where light dies, NOT warm energy, NOT fire). Incomplete or broken masks. Broken Gate stone embedded in body (fragments of the original Mythos Gates fused into the form). Negative-space wounds (holes showing ACTIVE NOTHING, the void that consumes). Anti-light seams (absolute black that drinks surrounding light). Ash falling UPWARD (gravity inverts around Hollow creatures).
CRITICAL: NOT EVIL, NOT DEMONIC — the Hollow is EROSION, not malice. It is absence, not corruption with intent. It should feel like looking at a wound in reality, not at a villain. Cold, silent, erasing, not raging or screaming.
CRITICAL: EPIC SCALE — this creature is large but SMALLER than deities. Deities are colossal (hundreds of feet tall). This creature is human-scale to slightly larger (8-15 feet tall). Low camera angle looking up. Show the creature emerging from a Gate fracture or void breach in the ground.
CRITICAL: Readable tactical RPG silhouette — the creature must be readable as a SWARMER unit at a glance. Clear weapon or threat indicator. Distinct silhouette from all other Hollow creatures.

Create Hollow Root Parasite, for Mythos Gates: Ascension. The Hollow threat faction.
Faction: The Hollow (non-playable threat faction).
Threat Tier: Minor.
Creature Category: Hollow Infestation.
Combat Role: SWARMER.
Canon: The Hollow is the anti-civilization that grows in the wound between Realms. It is what the Mythos Gates were built to keep sealed. When the Gates broke, the Hollow came through. This creature carries fragments of broken Gate stone in its body — not as armor, but as the scar of its own creation. Where deities are alive, this creature is absence. Where deities radiate, this creature absorbs.

ART STYLE: Premium dark mythological tactical RPG enemy concept art. Grim dark aesthetic. The Hollow should feel WRONG — like looking at something that should not exist. Not scary in a monster way, but unsettling in an existential way. This is not a demon or a beast — it is a WOUND IN REALITY wearing a shape it stole from something that was real. Painterly textures, deep shadows, void-black depths.

HOLLOW ROOT PARASITE — A black root-serpent that infests and erases terrain.

BODY: Serpentine, root-like form — 8-12 feet long, winding. NOT a snake, NOT a plant — a void-stuff tendril shaped like a root. The body is charcoal-black, segmented like root-growth, with pale white sap-cracks running along its length (NOT glowing sap, but anti-light leaking through the cracks). The body is thin, winding, branching — like a root system that grows through reality and devours it. Multiple tendrils branch off the main body.

HEAD: A thorn-mouth — the front of the root-serpent opens into a crown of void-stuff thorns arranged in a mouth shape. No eyes. No face. Just the thorn-mouth, opening to reveal ACTIVE NOTHING inside — the void that consumes terrain.

TAIL: The tail trails into soil — NOT resting on soil, but GROWING INTO it. The tail-end of the Root Parasite is fused with the ground, as if the creature is an extension of the terrain itself. This is how it infests — it becomes part of the ground and erases it from within.

GATE STONE: Tiny Gate-stone fragments embedded along the body like nodes — small dark stones at intervals along the root-length, each pulsing with cold white anti-light. The stones are the seeds of the infestation, dropped from the broken Gate.

POSE: Winding through the ground, half-buried, emerging from cracks in the earth. The thorn-mouth is visible, opening toward the viewer. Several smaller root-tendrils branch off and disappear into the ground. The creature should look like it is GROWING through the battlefield, not walking on it.

SCALE: 8-12 feet of visible body — but the full extent is unknown because it extends into the ground. Camera at ground level, looking at the thorn-mouth emerging from cracked earth. Tiny rubble and broken stones for scale.

GROUND: The ground around the Root Parasite is WRONG — it is being ERASED. Patches of earth are fading to void, turning to nothing. Root-trails of white anti-light spread through the ground like an infection. Soil clinging UPWARD — chunks of earth floating up, detached from reality. The ground looks like it is being consumed from below.

BACKGROUND: Dark void environment with a TERRAIN focus — the battlefield itself is the victim. Broken Gate-arches in the distance, but the foreground is the infested ground, cracking and fading. Palette: charcoal-black, void-dark brown, cold white, pale sap-anti-light blue-white.

VFX: Anti-light sap leaking from cracks. Thorn-mouth opening to reveal void. Root-tendrils spreading through ground. Earth floating upward in chunks. White anti-light infection-patterns spreading across the ground.

SILHOUETTE: Serpentine, winding, emerging from ground. Reads as a swarmer/infestation unit — the root-shape and ground-emergence are the primary identifiers. Should look like a parasite growing through reality, not a creature standing on it.
